result.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
result.summary: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos. Each delivery is scored along two evaluation dimensions. Rule-based Scene Check re-runs the code and compares the exported 4D scene with hidden ground truth facts in nine dimensions. VLM-based Screen Check asks a VLM judge whether the facts that pass can be recognized in the proxy video. We analyze the evaluation results and trajectories of 11 frontier coding agents and identify three key observations. First, multimodal understanding separates the agents, especially in understanding space and camera motion. Second, all agents seem to already master basic camera work and staging, and fail at challenging requests. Third, agents inspect their own renders but fail to correct their errors. Agents thus need better visual understanding of space and camera, explicit checks for challenging requests, and item-by-item verification of renders against the brief.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 VibePrevisBench：242 个任务要求编码 agent 依据脚本、照片、续写或参考视频，在 Blender 中重建可执行的 4D 场景并渲染 graybox 代理视频，再用规则化场景核对与 VLM 判定的事实核查两维度评分，并分析 11 个前沿 agent 的轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 「agent 会查看自身渲染却无法据此纠错」以及空间/相机理解差异，可能可供核查视觉证据获取与验证闭环如何影响多模态推理；但任务是 4D 场景生成与编码评测，不涉及 latent 推理状态。
